note: Saved cost in seconds of each case of a sharded suite, by suite name and case name, taken from the case timings of the last gate or hosted run (run_checks_e2e: the four hosted samples shards of run 44930295246, Nov 21 2026). scripts/quality/case_shards.py packs the cases of a suite into its shards by these costs, heaviest first, each case into the lightest shard. A case without a cost is packed with the median cost, and a suite without costs goes round robin in inventory order. A cost changes only the balance, never which cases run. The costs of run_checks_e2e are the seconds of the cases rows in the shard manifests (manifest.json) of hosted CI run 43730985805 of Nov 15 2026 (head 0033aaf, four shard jobs on separate hosted runners, 803 cases, 7662 seconds in all). The earlier Nov 14 2026 costs came from a validation run on a Mac and its total of 4361 seconds is 0.57 times the hosted total. Fourteen privacy-scan cases of workbook and PDF samples have no hosted cost: their costs were measured locally on one Mac on 2026-11-20 as the mean of three timed runs of each case through run_case of scripts.quality.run_checks_e2e (rounded to 0.001 s), not taken from the hosted run. Three privacy-scan cases that do have a hosted cost took 3.35 to 3.54 s on the same Mac against 3.43 to 5.65 s hosted.
